name: Neuland Laboratories Ltd
title: Neuland Laboratories Ltd - 524558 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 record revenue was lumpy and FX-aided; FY26 revenue INR2053.1 crores (+37.1%) but FCF negative INR49.4 crores as working capital days rose to 137, with capex INR397.1 crores and no formal guidance.

utilisation.quote: the current capacity utilization of those 3 units are close to between 85% to 90% and the last unit is around 65%

capex.quote: Capex cash outflow for FY 26 was INR397.1 crores.

triggers.label: Working capital days 107 → 137
triggers.quote: Working capital days stood at 137 days in Q4FY26 versus 107 days in Q4FY25

triggers.label: No formal guidance going forward
triggers.quote: we do not intend to do so going forward

triggers.label: ROCE to moderate on longer capex cycles
triggers.quote: While our ROCE remains healthy, it is expected to moderate as we enter longer capital deployment cycles.

triggers.label: Q4 margin 40.5% flagged as non-recurring
triggers.quote: should not be seen as an indicator of our future performance

guidance.quote: I think the 18% to 20% is a fair assumption not necessarily linearly.
the facility will be ready by July as per schedule. There has been no change in the date for that.

prior_guidance_check.quote: this outlook was accurate. We have achieved the kind of performance that we anticipated at the beginning of the year.

red_flags.label: Working capital days up to 137 with negative FCF
red_flags.quote: For the FY26, the free cash flow was negative at INR49.4 crores, driven primarily by higher working capital during the year

red_flags.label: Analyst alleges inventory-related transcript edits; management to revert
red_flags.quote: I'll have to check back on what you have mentioned and then revert back to you, Shilpa.

red_flags.label: Customer M&A exposure on bempedoic acid; cannot comment
red_flags.quote: we will not be able to comment or acknowledge what molecules we make for whom

evasions.quote: I would not probably get into a debate in terms of whether this is attractive or not.
I don't know off top of my head what the H2 versus H1 is. So, I don't want to comment on it.
